tours.name: The Adventure Pass
tours.short_description: The Adventure Pass provides incredible savings of up to 40% on the most popular attractions and experiences across Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
tours.about: The Adventure Pass provides incredible savings of up to 40% on the most popular attractions and experiences across Dubai and Abu Dhabi. Now offering over 30+ unique activities in 3 or 5 activity passes, there’s more choice and value than ever before to be unlocked by both visitors and residents of Dubai. Download the Adventure Pass to your phone, book your favourite activities as you go, and pay one single price while enjoying the city’s most sought after experiences.
tours.full_description:
Value, flexibility, endless activities - The Adventure Pass offers so much more than just Dubai’s and Abu Dhabi's most popular attractions in one place. For a fixed price, both visitors and residents in the amazing city of Dubai can enjoy over 30+ activities whilst saving up to 40% on standard prices. With tickets stored conveniently on your mobile device, you can explore the best of Dubai, for less, with seamless convenience and flexibility.

With The Adventure Pass, over 30+ exciting, cultural, family-friendly attractions are in the palm of your hand. Whether you’re heading for the dunes on an The Fort-Lisaili, want to take a leap of faith at Atlantis Aquaventure, or seek a charming boat ride across the Dubai Marina, the Adventure Pass is your ticket to experience the best of Dubai.

The Adventure Pass is available in both 3 adventure and 5 adventure packages. Both passes are available for a fixed price, which doesn’t change based on the activities you choose to enjoy. The Adventure Pass must be registered and activated on the Smartvisit app within 6 months of the date of purchase, and is valid for 7 days after redeeming the first experience on your pass.
tours.know_before_you_go:
The Adventure Pass is available in 3 or 5 activity packages for a fixed price. Each package includes The Fort – Lisaili plus your choice of 2 or 4 additional adventures. The price remains the same regardless of which activities you select for your Adventure Pass
For Arabian Adventures Desert Safari
Once you have purchased your Adventure Pass, it will be available on the Smartvisit app. You can download this app in the App Store for iPhone, or Google Play store for Android devices, or by following the link to get started: ( https://app.smartvisit.com/download )
There will be a ticket number printed underneath the QR code once you complete your purchase. Use this ticket number to add the Adventure Pass to the Smartvisit app
Some activities will require advanced booking. Please check the unique booking conditions for each activity directly
You will be required to complete registration when you download the Smartvisit app. This is a normal part of the process and we encourage you to complete this step upon downloading the app
Please share any pre-existing medical conditions with the respective venues prior to attending your activities
The Adventure Pass is valid for 7 days from redeeming the first experience
Your Adventure Pass must be registered and activated on the Smartvisit app within 6 months from date of purchase
tours.additional_notes:
What's included:
3 or 5 experiences, depending on your pass, including:
The Fort - Lisaili - Desert Experience in a shared 4-wheel drive ( children need to be min 5 years old to participate)
Sea Camel self-drive boat tour (Two passes are needed per Sea Camel. Single riders are required to pay a single supplement of AED 250 direct to the supplier)
Admission to Wild Wadi Waterpark, next to the Burj Al Arab
Admission to Aquaventure Waterpark at Atlantis the Palm
Tickets to explore the underwater world of The Lost World Aquarium in Atlantis the Palm (re-opening 27th October)
Access to the slopes at Ski Dubai in Mall of the Emirates, on a Snow Classic Package
Admission to At The Top Burj Khalifa, Levels 124 & 125, where you’ll stand at one of the highest man-made heights in the world
Tickets to explore the Dubai Frame, seeing both old and new Dubai from a unique perspective
Hop-on, hop-off bus tickets for City Sightseeing Dubai
Tickets to the thrilling IMG Worlds of Adventure theme park
A 2 Park Pass at Dubai Parks & Resorts (requires 2 tickets from your Adventure Pass)
Access to The View at the Palm, providing panoramic views of Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Beach Residence, and out to the Burj Al Arab
A Dubai Marina Sunset Dhow Cruise, hosted by Tour Dubai
A Dubai Marina Breakfast Cruise, hosted by Xclusive Yachts
Louvre General Admission Ticket (Abu Dhabi)
Madame Tussauds General Admission
Abra Tours Marina Promenade Cruise
Museum of Illusions - General Admission
Mercedes-Benz Off Road Experience (ride along)
The Black Boats - 60 min Atlantis Tour
Qasr Al Watan - General Admission (Abu Dhabi)

Al Shindagha Museum Entry Ticket

What's not included:
Transfers to and from your hotel or residence to the attractions, unless specifically mentioned within the product

tours.name: Private Highlights of Dubai City Tour
tours.short_description: The Highlights of Dubai tour is the best way to see the key attractions of the city, including the cultural symbols of the Jumeirah Mosque, the record-breaking Burj Khalifa and the iconic Dubai Mall.
tours.about:
The Highlights of Dubai tour is the best way to see the key attractions of the city, including the cultural symbols of the Jumeirah Mosque, the record-breaking Burj Khalifa and the iconic Dubai Mall. This full day tour includes a venture into both old and new, showcasing the heritage of the Dubai Creek – upon which the city’s story started many centuries ago – before finishing in the ambitious, modern, forward-thinking new Dubai, home to instantly recognisable structures and a city forged in the future.

The Highlights of Dubai tour showcases the very best landmarks of Dubai in one fun-filled day of adventure. Starting with a pickup from your hotel or residence, the tour takes you and your guests across the bustling city of Dubai, filled with sights and culture.
tours.image_alt: Private Highlights of Dubai City Tour
tours.pickup_information: Start your adventure with a comfortable pickup from your hotel or residence. Guests may also select their preferred start time. We recommend an early start time to ensure you can enjoy the full itinerary and all planned attractions.
tours.know_before_you_go:
Please note, this is a full day tour lasting approximately 10 hours. Starting times for the tour are flexible between 8am – 10am, depending on guest preferences
Pick-up times for this tour are approximate and may vary. To avoid any delays, please be ready in the hotel’s main lobby before the scheduled time and inform the hotel concierge that you are waiting for an Arabian Adventures tour pick-up
We recommend wearing comfortable clothing, including walking shoes, for this tour
If At The Top Burj Khalifa is added to your itinerary as an optional extra, a transfer back to your hotel or residence at the end of the tour is not included
Please note: an AED 200 surcharge will be added for pick-ups from Abu Dhabi, Ras al Khaimah, Umm al Quwain, Al Ain and Fujairah.
tours.cancellation_policy:
We understand that your plans can change. Please contact our team at least 24 hours before your activity to discuss your booking, should you wish to cancel. If you cancel less than 24 hours before your activity is due to start, we will unfortunately be unable to process a refund
If you would like to keep your booking but amend the day of your tour, we will work to accommodate this. However, we cannot guarantee availability
Our operating schedules, routes and activities may be adapted during the holy month of Ramadan, and during the summer months. Please check before you travel if your tour is during the relevant periods
Unforeseen circumstances beyond our or our suppliers’ control may result in cancellation without notice. We reserve the right to cancel or alter activities in such situations. Should a sudden unforeseen circumstance affect your scheduled activity, please reach out to our team to discuss next steps
We reserve the right to cancel your booking if full payment has not been made at least 2 days prior to your scheduled activity
We reserve the right to amend schedules and bookings if business operations require
tours.additional_notes:
This product is not available for online bookings. Please request a callback.

To book this tour in languages other than English, please contact us via WhatsApp.

tours.name: Private Al Ain City Tour
tours.short_description: Join Arabian Adventures for a peaceful journey to Al Ain, approximately 120 kilometres from Dubai.
tours.about:
Join Arabian Adventures for a peaceful journey to Al Ain, approximately 120 kilometres from Dubai. Our inspiring Al Ain City Tour takes in forts, museums, parks and Jebel Hafeet, the second-highest mountain in the UAE.

Enjoy a full day exploring the beautiful city of Al Ain, near the border with Oman. The second largest city in Abu Dhabi is known for its gorgeous palm groves and natural springs, which have earned it the nickname ‘Garden City’.
tours.pickup_information: Begin your journey with a comfortable pickup from your hotel or residence. Guests may also select their preferred start time. We recommend an early start time to ensure you can enjoy the full itinerary and all planned attractions.
tours.know_before_you_go:
Based on the guests’ preference, the tour can start as early as 8:00 am, but no later than 10 am. The duration of the tour is about 10 hours
Pick-up times for this tour are approximate and may vary. To avoid any delays, please be ready in the hotel’s main lobby before the scheduled time and inform the hotel concierge that you are waiting for an Arabian Adventures tour pick-up
We advise wearing comfortable shoes, and all guests must adhere to the local dress code requirements (modest clothing with shoulders and knees covered). We also recommend wearing sunblock, sunglasses, and a hat, especially during the summer months
The tour runs every day except on Mondays and public holidays
tours.age_policy:
Adults are 12 years and above
Child age is 2-11 years
tours.cancellation_policy:
Schedules, prices, routings and information published here are correct at this time, but are subject to variation without notice.
Our operating schedules and the routes of some of our tours and safaris may change during the holy month of Ramadan, and during the summer months, or due to force majeure.
We reserve the right to cancel any tour or alter any part of the tour at our discretion without prior notification.
The full price of any Activity shall be due and payable when a booking is made and we may cancel any booking if the full price of the Activity is not paid to us at least two (2) days prior to commencement of the said Activity.
We shall be entitled to cancel, alter or omit any part of any Activity for which a booking has been made with or without notice to you and at our sole discretion. In particular, due to the nature of many of the Activities, delays and cancellations may result due to factors beyond our or our suppliers’ control, such as the weather, accidents, sickness, governmental restrictions and other events of force majeure. In such cases, a refund or partial refund may be given at our discretion and/or the discretion of the supplier of the Activity concerned.
No refund will be payable to you in respect of a booking cancelled less than twenty four (24) hours prior to commencement of an Activity.
Failure to arrive at the designated location for an Activity by the specified departure time shall be considered to be cancellation.

tours.name: Private Authentic Dubai Food Tour
tours.short_description: In a city famous for skyscrapers, 5-star hotels and beautiful beaches, look a little closer and you’ll find so much more to celebrate – including a world of incredible, culture-filled food.
tours.about:
In a city famous for skyscrapers, 5-star hotels and beautiful beaches, look a little closer and you’ll find so much more to celebrate – including a world of incredible, culture-filled food. Our Authentic Dubai Food Tour stops at the city’s main food highlights on the Dubai Creek, travelling through restaurants where communities once came together to socialise and enjoy the very same foods you’ll eat on this tour.

Our Authentic Dubai Food Tour takes place in the heart of old Dubai, where the city’s first communities settled and developed the cuisine we enjoy today.
tours.pickup_information: Begin your private tour at your preferred start time, booked in advance. Guests may select their preferred tour start time, subject to the availability of our tour guides. Please book your scheduled time in advance.

Arabic sweets and desserts at Arabian Tea House Restaurant
tours.know_before_you_go:

Pick-up times for this tour are approximate and may vary. To avoid any delays, please be ready in the hotel’s main lobby before the scheduled time and inform the hotel concierge that you are waiting for an Arabian Adventures tour pick-up
Our Authentic Dubai Food Tour operates either between 11:00 – 15:00 for lunchtime tours (winter only), or 16:30 – 20:30 for sunset dinner experiences. If you would like to request an alternative starting time based on your preferences, please reach out and we will do our best to accommodate
We recommend wearing comfortable shoes as this tour involves walking

tours.short_description: The Traditional Dubai Tour is a whistlestop journey through the heritage, culture and classic architecture of Dubai’s old city.
tours.about:
The Traditional Dubai Tour is a whistlestop journey through the heritage, culture and classic architecture of Dubai’s old city. For anyone looking to experience the cultural fabric of Dubai on a short and fruitful trip, there’s no better way to do so than on a Traditional Dubai Tour.

This itinerary offers a rich, half-day journey through the customs, traditions and ways of living that continue to thrive in Old Dubai. The old side of the city still has the hum, bustle and cultural foundations that it’s had for many centuries and is as appealing and fascinating as Dubai’s array of modern achievements.

tours.short_description: Dubai was mostly desert not so long ago, with a small population living near the Dubai Creek.
tours.about:
Dubai was mostly desert not so long ago, with a small population living near the Dubai Creek. Today, it’s a bustling global city, home to some of the world’s most recognisable buildings and beautiful backdrops. On the Modern Dubai City Tour, you’ll see the side of the city that was once a dream, now turned into an incredible reality.

The Modern Dubai City Tour is a window in the world of New Dubai. The tour showcases the man-made side of the city, borne out of the vision, ambition and imagination of the leaders of the UAE. On this tour, you’ll see the most instantly recognisable sights and landmarks of Dubai up close.

tours.name: Private Highlights of Abu Dhabi
tours.short_description: The highlights of Abu Dhabi tour showcases the culture, heritage and natural wonder of the nation’s capital city.
tours.about:
The highlights of Abu Dhabi tour showcases the culture, heritage and natural wonder of the nation’s capital city. In the company of our knowledgeable, hospitable, professional tour guides, you’ll be taken on a full day tour of the city’s best sights and activities, including skyline views from Etihad Towers, the world-famous Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, and the crossroads of religion in the Abrahamic Family House. Private transfers to and from Abu Dhabi from your hotel residence are included as part of this inspiring one-day activity.

There's a lot to be discovered when you head to the capital city. Away from the record-breaking skyscrapers of Dubai, you'll find a city that's full of charm, nature, culture - and a few record-breaking achievements of its own.
tours.pickup_information: Start your adventure with a comfortable pickup from your hotel or residence. Guests may also select their preferred start time. We recommend an early start time to ensure you can enjoy the full itinerary and all planned attractions.
tours.know_before_you_go:
This is a full day tour. We recommend that you wear comfortable clothing that also adheres to local requirements. Shoulders and knees must be covered, to ensure smooth entry to Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and other cultural attractions.
Pick-up times for this tour are approximate and may vary. To avoid any delays, please be ready in the hotel’s main lobby before the scheduled time and inform the hotel concierge that you are waiting for an Arabian Adventures tour pick-up
Please bring bottles of water to keep suitably hydrated throughout the day.
The sun in the UAE can be intense at any time of year. While this tour does not include too much time exposed to the sun, we recommend wearing sunblock, and bringing sunglasses and a hat should you so wish.
There will be a lunch opportunity within the food court at Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque. Any purchases are not covered in your activity fee.
Important Dress Code Information: The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Qasr Al Watan hold religious significance for all Muslims. Guests are required to adhere strictly to the local dress code by wearing modest clothing that covers the shoulders and knees (male & female). Transparent or tight-fitting attire is not permitted, as well as clothing featuring cartoon character images, is not permitted. Arabian Adventures cannot be held responsible if entry is denied due to non-compliance with mosque/palace etiquette. For detailed guidelines, we recommend visiting the respective partner websites.
Presidential events can sometimes mean access to Qasr Al Watan is prohibited at short notice. Qasr al Hosn will replace this activity should this occur.
You will be visiting spiritual places of great significance to local culture. Please ensure you respect their significance throughout your time on the tour.
We welcome you to bring along your own snacks to keep in a backpack. If you are to bring a backpack to any of the activities, please be prepared for it to be searched when entering certain venues. We request you to make yourself aware of any prohibited items at each venue, and ensure you comply with venue regulations.
